name: unclosed-vec
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[1 2 3"
  :marker "      ^"
  :message "`[` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `]` completes the source"
  :expected ["]"]
  :location ::span[6 1 7 6 1 7]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: unclosed-map
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "{:a 1"
  :marker "     ^"
  :message "`{` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `}` completes the source"
  :expected ["}"]
  :location ::span[5 1 6 5 1 6]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: unclosed-set
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "#[:a"
  :marker "    ^"
  :message "`#[` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `]` completes the source"
  :expected ["]"]
  :location ::span[4 1 5 4 1 5]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: unclosed-paren
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "(1 | add(2)"
  :marker "           ^"
  :message "`(` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `)` completes the source"
  :expected [")"]
  :location ::span[11 1 12 11 1 12]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: unclosed-string
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "\"hello"
  :marker "      ^"
  :message "`\"` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `\"` completes the source"
  :expected ["\""]
  :location ::span[6 1 7 6 1 7]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: trailing-pipe
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[1 2 3] |"
  :marker "         ^"
  :expected [:whitespace]
  :location ::span[9 1 10 9 1 10]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: map-without-value
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "{:k}"
  :marker "   ^"
  :expected [:"identifier continue (letter, digit, hyphen, underscore)" "/" :whitespace]
  :found "}"
  :location ::span[3 1 4 4 1 5]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: double-pipe
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[1] || count"
  :marker "   ^~       "
  :message "a combinator is set off by whitespace on both sides: write ` | `"
  :location ::span[3 1 4 5 1 6]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: call-stray-comma
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "add(,1)"
  :marker "    ^  "
  :expected [:whitespace "!|" "|" ":" "::" :"identifier start (letter or underscore)" "/" "(" "!{" "#\"" "#[" "[" "{" "~(" "~" "\"" :"number within the finite double range" "true" "false" "null" :doc]
  :found ","
  :location ::span[4 1 5 5 1 6]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: nested-unclosed-bracket
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[{:a 1]"
  :marker "      ^"
  :expected [:whitespace "}" ":" "(" "::" "!{" "#\"" "#[" "[" "{" "~(" "~" "/" :"identifier start (letter or underscore)" "\"" :"number within the finite double range" "true" "false" "null" :doc]
  :found "]"
  :location ::span[6 1 7 7 1 8]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: dangling-path-slash
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "/foo/"
  :marker "     ^"
  :expected [":" "\"" :"identifier start (letter or underscore)" :"identifier continue (letter, digit, hyphen, underscore)"]
  :location ::span[5 1 6 5 1 6]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: empty-keyword
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source ":"
  :marker " ^"
  :expected ["\"" :"identifier start (letter or underscore)"]
  :location ::span[1 1 2 1 1 2]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: invalid-string-escape
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "\"\\q\""
  :marker "  ^ "
  :expected ["\"" "\\" "/" "n" "t" "r" "b" "f" "u"]
  :found "q"
  :location ::span[2 1 3 3 1 4]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: number-literal-past-the-finite-domain
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "1e400"
  :marker "^    "
  :expected [:whitespace "!|" "|" ":" "::" :"identifier start (letter or underscore)" "/" "(" "!{" "#\"" "#[" "[" "{" "~(" "~" "\"" :"number within the finite double range" "true" "false" "null" :doc :end-of-input]
  :found "1"
  :location ::span[0 1 1 1 1 2]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: number-literal-inside-the-finite-domain-parses
expect: true

name: incomplete-unicode-escape
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "\"\\u12\""
  :marker "     ^"
  :expected [:char-class]
  :found "\""
  :location ::span[5 1 6 6 1 7]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-word-after-a-literal-step
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "1 2"
  :marker "  ^"
  :message "steps are joined by `|`: write `a | b`"
  :location ::span[2 1 3 3 1 4]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-modifier-against-the-one-before
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "add (1)(2)"
  :marker "       ^~~"
  :message "words are set off by whitespace; only the first modifier of a command may touch its name, `f(a) (b)`"
  :location ::span[7 1 8 10 1 11]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: a-call-by-habit-inside-a-literal
expect:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[mul(2) add(1)]"
  :marker "    ^~~        "
  :message "the words of a literal are set off by whitespace: `[1 2]`"
  :location ::span[4 1 5 7 1 8]
  :trail []
} | raise

name: the-flatten-combinator-is-no-token
expect: ::quote/ParseError

name: a-pipe-after-the-catch-keeps-the-catch
expect: "`|` written after `!|` is the habit of a pipe before every step: write `a !| b`"

name: a-catch-after-the-catch-stands-once
expect: "`!|` written after `!|`: a combinator stands once between two steps, write `a !| b`"

name: a-parse-error-names-no-marker-of-a-comment-among-its-continuations
expect: false

name: an-unclosed-bracket-names-where-it-opened
expect: true

name: a-doc-after-a-step-is-refused
expect: true

name: a-source-no-short-run-of-closers-completes-lists-the-continuations
expect: true

name: a-set-written-with-braces-names-its-brackets
expect: true

name: a-quote-written-with-braces-names-its-parentheses
expect: "a quote is written `~(…)`, its code in parentheses; `{…}` is a map and `[…]` a vector"

name: a-pipe-after-a-combinator-names-the-form-that-keeps-it
expect: true

name: a-tag-in-the-place-of-a-name-declares-nothing
expect: ::quote/ParseError
